IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: IMT WORKS WITH GOVERNMENT, BUSINESS, & COMMUNITY PARTNERS TO IMPROVE BUILDINGS & CREATE JOBS.
IRS990.MissionDesc: IMT BELIEVES BETTER BUILDINGS IMPROVE LIVES. IMT'S MISSION IS TO CATALYZE DEMAND FOR HIGH-PERFORMING BUILDINGS.
IRS990.Desc: POLICY: IMT WORKS TO ACTIVATE GOVERNMENT AT THE FEDERAL, STATE, AND LOCAL LEVELS TO USE THE REGULATORY LEVERS AVAILABLE TO ADDRESS BUILDING PERFORMANCE. FOR MORE THAN 25 YEARS, IMT HAS WORKED WITH POLICYMAKERS AND STAKEHOLDERS TO CO-DESIGN AND IMPLEMENT BUILDING CODES AND POLICIES AT EVERY LEVEL TO DRIVE DEMAND FOR HEALTHY, RESILIENT, LOW-POLLUTION BUILDINGS. IMT CURRENTLY LEADS THE NATIONAL BPS COALITION, WHICH AIMS TO CATALYZE $132 BILLION IN INVESTMENT IN HIGH PERFORMANCE BUILDINGS THAT LOWER ENERGY COSTS FOR RESIDENTS AND BUSINESSES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT: IMT BELIEVES COMMUNITIES WHICH EXPERIENCE THE GREATEST CHALLENGES SHOULD DRIVE THEIR OWN SOLUTIONS. IMT FACILIITATES CONVERSATION, PROVIDES CONNECTIONS, AND OFFERS TECHNICAL EXPERTISE TO SUPPORT COMMUNITY-DRIVEN POLICY RESPONSES THAT BENEFIT ALL RESIDENTS, AND CREATE ECONOMIC OPPORTUNITIES FOR FRONTLINE COMMUNITIES. IMT WORKS WITH MORE THAN 100 PARTNERS ACROSS ALL OF OUR PROJECTS TO ENSURE POLICIES SUPPORT AFFORDABILITY AND COMMUNITY PRIORITIES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT: IMT HELPS THE PRIVATE SECTOR MEET THEIR CURRENT AND FUTURE BUILDING ENERGY NEEDS, WHILE PUSHING THE MARKET TOWARD HIGH-PERFORMING BUILDINGS AS A NEW NORMAL. IMT PROVIDES GREEN LEASING CERTIFICATION THAT REDUCES ENERGY COSTS; AWARDEES CURRENTLY OWN OR MANAGE 8.1 BILLION SQ FT OF SPACE. IMT ALSO PROVIDES KEY POLICY DATA AND INSIGHTS THROUGH ITS CORPORATE ENGAGEMENT OPPORTUNITIES PROGRAM. ADDITIONALLY, IMT HELPS THE REAL ESTATE SECTOR MEET SHIFTING MARKET DEMANDS THROUGH ITS BUILDING PERFORMANCE PARTNERSHIP AND ITS BUILDING INNOVATION HUB IN WASHINGTON, DC.
